name: BSEL Algo Ltd.
summary: BSEL Algo Ltd. operates primarily as an investment holding company, with its business interests spanning both infrastructure development and the hospitality industry, encompassing hotels and resorts. The firm's notable endeavors include the Dubai Project, Ajman, BSEL Buty Palace and Rewa Bhavan, Y Junction, and Kevadia Project Phase I. Established on November 15, 1995, BSEL Algo Ltd. maintains its corporate headquarters in Mumbai, India.
